title: The promenade round the major set is the progression
assumes: The neighbour promenade counterclockwise round the major set is the travel: it walks you the whole way to number two's place and lets go there, so the cast back is already a figure of the new seating rather than the last step of the old one.
quotes: A1  (8) Ladies chain to neighbor  (8) Neighbor promenade counterclockwise around the major set
notes: The record's own clause on A2's cast-back is removed, so this reading has exactly one: the promenade carries it, at the promenade's end. The two are a hair apart in beats — the cast back begins where the promenade stops — and what differs is which call is danced in which seating and whether the dancers the call leaves out slide with their line. **Measured, and it is the finding**: this reading is **identical to the record at every checked length** — `closure 0.0000 · progressed 37.7359 · reach 2.5791 short · collision 1.895` at 4–12, in every digit. There are no beats between the promenade's end and the cast-back's start, so `"progresses": true` on the one and `"progresses": "start"` on the other are the same instant, and the hold-place slide has nobody to move because the promenade leaves nobody out. DD43's choice was a choice of words rather than of dancing, and what this dance is really being asked is whether the shift belongs before the cast back at all.
